description: Main backend implementation for a FastAPI-based conversational AI service, including endpoints for health checks, chat interactions (both streaming and non-streaming), and OpenAI client initialization.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a single chat message with a role and content, with validation for role values.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: Schema for incoming chat requests, including message and optional context.

classes.name: ChatResponse
classes.description: Schema for responses containing the assistant's reply.

methods.name: _get_openai_client
methods.description: Lazily imports and initializes the OpenAI client, handling both v1 SDK and legacy openai package.
